cases.input: Synthetic AP/services accrual, October 2026: owner policy says straight calendar-day allocation and day-1 auto-reversal. Contract basis $12,400 covers 31/31 days of services received; GL already includes $3,100 for this contract and period; account mapping supplied as service expense / accrued liability. Draft entry.

criteria: Calculates period portion $12,400 × 31/31 = $12,400 and remaining accrual $12,400 − $3,100 = $9,300.
Proposes Dr service expense $9,300 / Cr accrued liability $9,300; debits equal credits.
Cites contract and GL evidence, records memo and owner-supplied day-1 reversal.
Does not post, invent policy or include the previously booked $3,100 twice.

cases.input: One required source is unavailable during journal entry preparation; provide useful unaffected draft work and identify the missing source.

Names exact missing evidence and impact
Uses NEEDS_CONTEXT only for blocked conclusion
